source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice short questions written from Unit 11 (PDF 288-298), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 11 (Vector Valued Functions and Their Derivatives (TOC: '...and Their Differentiations')) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.
11.1 Scalar And Vector-Valued Functions Of A Single Variable

blocks.prompt:
1 What is a vector-valued function? Give one use of it.
(Vector-valued function kya hai? Is ka aik istemal batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Vector-valued function aik number \(t\) (aam tor par waqt) le kar vector deta hai jis ki magnitude aur direction hoti hai, maslan \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\). Yeh position, velocity ya force ko model karta hai, maslan satellite ki position.

book_ref.quote: Vector-valued functions return vectors with both magnitude and direction

blocks.prompt:
2 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (t + 1)\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\), find the points for \(t = -1, 0, 1\) and the equation of the path.
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = (t + 1)\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\) ke liye \(t = -1, 0, 1\) par points aur raaste ki equation (muadla) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: This means at time \(t\), the particle is at the point

blocks.prompt:
3 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (2000\cos t)\hat{i} + (2000\sin t)\hat{j} + 1000t\,\hat{k}\) (km, \(t\) in hours), show that the \(xy\)-motion is a circle and find the rise in one full turn.
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = (2000\cos t)\hat{i} + (2000\sin t)\hat{j} + 1000t\,\hat{k}\) (km, \(t\) ghante) ke liye dikhayein ke \(xy\)-harkat circle hai aur aik chakkar mein oopar uthna nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 2000^{2}\): radius 2000 km ka circle. Aik chakkar mein \(t\) \(2\pi\) barhta hai, \(z\) \(2000\pi \approx 6283\) km barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: model the satellite's circular orbit in the

blocks.prompt:
4 Define a scalar function and give an example.
(Scalar function ki definition likhein aur misal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar domain ke har \(t\) ke liye aik munfarid (unique) scalar \(f\) mile to \(f\), \(t\) ka scalar function hai; real-valued function hi scalar function hai. Misal: \(f(t) = t^{2} + 4\sin t\).

book_ref.quote: A real-valued function is commonly called a scalar function

blocks.prompt:
5 Evaluate the scalar function \(f(t) = t^{2} + 4\sin t\) at \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) and \(t = \pi\).
(Scalar function \(f(t) = t^{2} + 4\sin t\) ko \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) aur \(t = \pi\) par nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(f\!\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\right) = \dfrac{\pi^{2}}{4} + 4\); \(f(\pi) = \pi^{2}\). Har jawab aik real number hai.

book_ref.quote: A scalar function is a function that assigns a single real number

blocks.prompt:
6 Write the general form of a vector-valued function in 3D and name its components.
(3D mein vector-valued function ki aam shakal likhein aur us ke components ke naam batayein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle f(t), g(t), h(t)\rangle = f(t)\,\hat{i} + g(t)\,\hat{j} + h(t)\,\hat{k}\); \(f, g, h\) aik hi \(t\) ke scalar functions (\(x\)-, \(y\)-, \(z\)-components) hain aur \(\hat{i}, \hat{j}, \hat{k}\) axes ke unit vectors.

book_ref.quote: takes one variable as input and returns a vector as output

blocks.prompt:
7 Write \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^{3}, e^{-t}, 2\rangle\) with unit vectors and find \(\mathbf{r}(1)\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle t^{3}, e^{-t}, 2\rangle\) ko unit vectors ke saath likhein aur \(\mathbf{r}(1)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{3}\,\hat{i} + e^{-t}\,\hat{j} + 2\,\hat{k}\); \(\mathbf{r}(1) = \hat{i} + \dfrac{1}{e}\,\hat{j} + 2\,\hat{k}\).

book_ref.quote: Each component of the output vector is itself a scalar function of the input

blocks.prompt:
8 Find \(|\mathbf{r}(t)|\) for \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + 2\sin t\,\hat{j} + t\,\hat{k}\). Is it scalar or vector?
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = 2\cos t\,\hat{i} + 2\sin t\,\hat{j} + t\,\hat{k}\) ke liye \(|\mathbf{r}(t)|\) nikalein. Yeh scalar hai ya vector?)
blocks.explanation: \(|\mathbf{r}(t)| = \sqrt{4 + t^{2}}\): har \(t\) ke liye aik number, is liye scalar function.

book_ref.quote: Each component of the output vector is itself a scalar function of the input

blocks.prompt:
9 State the three steps for constructing a vector-valued function.
(Vector-valued function banane ke teen qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Qadam 1: components maloom karein (har coordinate \(t\) ke saath kaise badalta hai). Qadam 2: unhein vector form mein likhein. Qadam 3: \(t\) ka domain batayein (motion ke liye \(t \ge 0\)).

book_ref.quote: Combine into Vector Form: Express the components as a single vector

blocks.prompt:
10 A particle starts at \(x = 1\) and its \(x\)-coordinate grows by 3 units per second, while \(y = 2t^{2}\), \(t \ge 0\). Construct \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
(Particle \(x = 1\) se shuru hota hai aur \(x\) har second 3 units barhta hai, jab ke \(y = 2t^{2}\), \(t \ge 0\). \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) banayein.)

book_ref.quote: Identify how each coordinate changes with respect to

blocks.prompt:
11 A ball is thrown from the origin with \(v_{0} = 30\) m/s at \(60^{\circ}\) to the horizontal (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)). Write its position vector.
(Ball origin se \(v_{0} = 30\) m/s aur horizontal se \(60^{\circ}\) par phenki gayi (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)). Position vector likhein.)

book_ref.quote: horizontal motion at constant speed

blocks.prompt:
12 A ball is thrown with \(v_{0} = 24.5\) m/s at \(30^{\circ}\) (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)). Find the domain of its position vector.
(Ball \(v_{0} = 24.5\) m/s aur \(30^{\circ}\) par phenki gayi (\(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\)). Position vector ka domain nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Specify the Domain: Define the range of

blocks.prompt:
13 A drone moves on \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3\cos t\,\hat{i} + 3\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.4t\,\hat{k}\) (m, s). Find the radius of its circle, its climbing rate and its climb per turn.
(Drone \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3\cos t\,\hat{i} + 3\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.4t\,\hat{k}\) (m, s) par chalta hai. Circle ka radius, oopar jaane ki raftaar aur aik chakkar mein climb nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 9\): radius 3 m. \(z = 0.4t\): 0.4 m/s. Aik chakkar \(2\pi\) s, climb \(= 0.8\pi \approx 2.51\) m.

book_ref.quote: represents the steady ascent at 0.5 meters per second

blocks.prompt:
14 Find the position of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 6\cos t\,\hat{i} + 6\sin t\,\hat{j} + 2t\,\hat{k}\) at \(t = \pi\) and at \(t = 2\pi\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = 6\cos t\,\hat{i} + 6\sin t\,\hat{j} + 2t\,\hat{k}\) ki position \(t = \pi\) aur \(t = 2\pi\) par nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{r}(\pi) \to (-6, 0, 2\pi)\); \(\mathbf{r}(2\pi) \to (6, 0, 4\pi)\), shuru ke point \((6, 0, 0)\) ke bilkul oopar.

book_ref.quote: represent the circular motion with a 5-meter radius

blocks.text: 11.2 Domain and Range of a Vector-Valued Function

blocks.prompt:
15 Define the domain of a vector-valued function.
(Vector-valued function ke domain ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = f(t)\,\hat{i} + g(t)\,\hat{j} + h(t)\,\hat{k}\) ka domain un tamam real \(t\) ka set hai jin par har component \(f, g, h\) defined ho.

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.prompt:
16 Find the domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t - 2}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{1}{t - 5}\,\hat{j}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t - 2}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{1}{t - 5}\,\hat{j}\) ka domain nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(t \ge 2\) aur \(t \ne 5\). Domain: \([2, 5) \cup (5, \infty)\).

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.prompt:
17 Find the domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \ln(t + 1)\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{4 - t}\,\hat{j} + \dfrac{1}{t}\,\hat{k}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \ln(t + 1)\,\hat{i} + \sqrt{4 - t}\,\hat{j} + \dfrac{1}{t}\,\hat{k}\) ka domain nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.prompt:
18 Find the domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sec t\,\hat{i} + e^{t}\,\hat{j}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sec t\,\hat{i} + e^{t}\,\hat{j}\) ka domain nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\sec t\) ke liye \(\cos t \ne 0\); \(e^{t}\) par koi shart nahin. Domain: \(t \ne \dfrac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\), \(n\) integer.

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.prompt:
19 Find the domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \cot t\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \cot t\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\) ka domain nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\cot t\) ke liye \(\sin t \ne 0\), yani \(t \ne n\pi\); \(t^{2}\) polynomial hai. Domain: \(n\pi\) ke siwa tamam real \(t\).

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.prompt:
20 Find the domain of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \ln(9 - t^{2})\,\hat{i} + t^{3}\,\hat{j}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \ln(9 - t^{2})\,\hat{i} + t^{3}\,\hat{j}\) ka domain nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: for which every component function

blocks.text: 11.2.1 Steps to Find the Domain of a Vector-Valued Function

blocks.prompt:
21 Write the steps to find the domain of a vector-valued function. What is its range?
(Vector-valued function ka domain nikalne ke qadam likhein. Is ki range kya hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Qadam 1: har component ka domain alag nikalein. Qadam 2: \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ka domain in sab ka intersection hai. Range: domain ke tamam \(t\) ke liye output vectors \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) ka set (curve ke points).

book_ref.quote: Find the intersection of the domains of each component

blocks.prompt:
22 Find the domain and range of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (t + 2)\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = (t + 2)\,\hat{i} + t^{2}\,\hat{j}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono components polynomial: domain \(\mathbb{R}\). \(x = t + 2\) se \(t = x - 2\); range parabola \(y = (x - 2)^{2}\) ke tamam points.

book_ref.quote: The range of a vector-valued function is the set of all possible output vectors

blocks.prompt:
23 Find the domain and range of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{16 - t^{2}}\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{16 - t^{2}}\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Domain \([-4, 4]\). \(x\) ki values \([0, 4]\), \(y = 3\) hamesha; range line segment \(\{(x, 3) : 0 \le x \le 4\}\).

book_ref.quote: Determine the domain of each component separately.

blocks.prompt:
24 For \(t \in [0, 3]\), find the values taken by the component \(y(t) = \dfrac{1}{t + 1}\).
(\(t \in [0, 3]\) ke liye component \(y(t) = \dfrac{1}{t + 1}\) ki values nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(1 \le t + 1 \le 4 \Rightarrow \dfrac{1}{4} \le y \le 1\).

book_ref.quote: The range of a vector-valued function is the set of all possible output vectors

blocks.prompt:
25 Find the domain and range of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{1 - t^{2}}\,\hat{i} + t\,\hat{j}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{1 - t^{2}}\,\hat{i} + t\,\hat{j}\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Domain \([-1, 1]\). \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 1\), \(x \ge 0\), aur \(y\) \([-1, 1]\) ki har value leta hai: range unit circle ka daayan aadha hissa.

book_ref.quote: The range of a vector-valued function is the set of all possible output vectors

blocks.prompt:
26 Is the point \(\left(3, \dfrac{1}{2}\right)\) in the range of \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t + 5}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{1}{t}\,\hat{j}\)?
(Kya point \(\left(3, \dfrac{1}{2}\right)\), \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t + 5}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{1}{t}\,\hat{j}\) ki range mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\sqrt{t + 5} = 3 \Rightarrow t = 4\), magar phir \(y = \dfrac{1}{4} \ne \dfrac{1}{2}\). Aik \(t\) dono components tay karta hai, is liye point range mein nahin.

book_ref.quote: The range of a vector-valued function is the set of all possible output vectors

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Range ke har point ke liye AIK hi \(t\) dono components deta hai. Is liye \(x\) ki range aur \(y\) ki range ke har jore (pair) ko range nahin keh sakte.
11.3 Identifying Scalar and Vector Valued Functions

blocks.prompt:
27 Why is it important to distinguish scalar and vector-valued functions?
(Scalar aur vector-valued functions mein farq karna kyun zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Output ki qisam tay karti hai ke us ke saath kya karna hai: scalar function aam real function ki tarah, vector-valued function component by component, aur us ka derivative vector hota hai (maslan velocity).

book_ref.quote: Understanding the distinction between scalar and vector-valued functions is crucial

blocks.prompt:
28 State the three criteria that identify a scalar function.
(Scalar function pehchanne ke teen criteria (usool) likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Aik hi numerical value deta hai. (ii) Aam tor par chhote letter se likha jata hai, maslan \(f(x)\). (iii) Temperature ya potential energy jaisi quantities batata hai.

book_ref.quote: Scalar-valued functions are typically denoted by lowercase letters

blocks.prompt:
29 Is \(P(x, y, z) = x^{2} + yz\) scalar or vector-valued? Find \(P(1, 2, 3)\).
(Kya \(P(x, y, z) = x^{2} + yz\) scalar hai ya vector-valued? \(P(1, 2, 3)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(P(1, 2, 3) = 1 + 6 = 7\): output aik number, is liye scalar-valued (teen inputs se vector nahin banta).

book_ref.quote: Scalar-valued functions produce a single numerical value

blocks.prompt:
30 Is \(\mathbf{F}(t) = \langle e^{t}, t^{2} - 1, 5\rangle\) scalar or vector-valued? Find \(\mathbf{F}(0)\).
(Kya \(\mathbf{F}(t) = \langle e^{t}, t^{2} - 1, 5\rangle\) scalar hai ya vector-valued? \(\mathbf{F}(0)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Output ordered triple (3D vector) hai aur naam bold hai, is liye vector-valued. \(\mathbf{F}(0) = \langle 1, -1, 5\rangle\).

book_ref.quote: Vector-valued functions produce a vector, often written as an ordered tuple

blocks.prompt:
31 Is \(g(t) = |3t\,\hat{i} + 4t\,\hat{j}|\) scalar or vector-valued? Simplify it.
(Kya \(g(t) = |3t\,\hat{i} + 4t\,\hat{j}|\) scalar hai ya vector-valued? Isay mukhtasar karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(g(t) = \sqrt{25t^{2}} = 5|t|\): aik real number, is liye scalar. Unit vectors magnitude ke andar hain, output mein nahin.

book_ref.quote: Scalar-valued functions produce a single numerical value

blocks.prompt:
32 Distinguish between a scalar function and a vector-valued function.
(Scalar function aur vector-valued function mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Farq table mein diya gaya hai.

book_ref.quote: Vector-valued functions describe quantities such as position, velocity, and force

blocks.prompt:
33 Define the derivative of a vector-valued function and state how it is computed.
(Vector-valued function ke derivative ki definition likhein aur batayein ke yeh kaise nikalta hai.)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = \displaystyle\lim_{\Delta t \to 0} \dfrac{\mathbf{r}(t + \Delta t) - \mathbf{r}(t)}{\Delta t}\). Limit maujood ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = f_{1}'(t)\,\hat{i} + f_{2}'(t)\,\hat{j} + f_{3}'(t)\,\hat{k}\): har component ko differentiate karein.

book_ref.quote: with respect to \(t\) is defined as:

blocks.prompt:
34 Find \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) if \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{4}\,\hat{i} - e^{-t}\,\hat{j} + \sin 2t\,\hat{k}\).
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{4}\,\hat{i} - e^{-t}\,\hat{j} + \sin 2t\,\hat{k}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
35 Find \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) if \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t\ln t\,\hat{i} + \cos^{2} t\,\hat{j}\), \(t > 0\).
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t\ln t\,\hat{i} + \cos^{2} t\,\hat{j}\), \(t > 0\), ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(t)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
36 Find \(\mathbf{r}'(4)\) if \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t^{2} + 9}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{t}{t + 2}\,\hat{j}\).
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \sqrt{t^{2} + 9}\,\hat{i} + \dfrac{t}{t + 2}\,\hat{j}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'(4)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: first differentiate each component in general, then substitute

blocks.prompt:
37 Find \(\mathbf{r}'\!\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)\) if \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \cos t\,\hat{i} + \sec t\,\hat{j} - \tan t\,\hat{k}\).
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \cos t\,\hat{i} + \sec t\,\hat{j} - \tan t\,\hat{k}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}'\!\left(\dfrac{\pi}{3}\right)\) nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = -\sin t\,\hat{i} + \sec t\tan t\,\hat{j} - \sec^{2}t\,\hat{k}\).

book_ref.quote: first differentiate each component in general, then substitute

blocks.prompt:
38 Find \(\mathbf{r}''(t)\) if \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{3}\,\hat{i} + e^{2t}\,\hat{j}\).
(Agar \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{3}\,\hat{i} + e^{2t}\,\hat{j}\) ho to \(\mathbf{r}''(t)\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: is computed by differentiating each component

blocks.prompt:
39 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + 3t\,\hat{j}\), explain why substituting \(t = 1\) before differentiating gives a wrong \(\mathbf{r}'(1)\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} + 3t\,\hat{j}\) mein differentiate karne se pehle \(t = 1\) rakhne se \(\mathbf{r}'(1)\) ghalat kyun aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle rakhne se constant vector \(\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\) milta hai, jis ka derivative \(\mathbf{0}\). Durust: \(\mathbf{r}'(t) = 2t\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\), \(\mathbf{r}'(1) = 2\,\hat{i} + 3\,\hat{j}\).

book_ref.quote: first differentiate each component in general, then substitute

blocks.prompt:
40 Define the velocity and acceleration of a particle with position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\).
(Position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) wale particle ki velocity aur acceleration ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Velocity \(\mathbf{v}(t) = \dfrac{d}{dt}\mathbf{r}(t)\), raaste ka tangent; acceleration \(\mathbf{a}(t) = \dfrac{d}{dt}\mathbf{v}(t) = \dfrac{d^{2}}{dt^{2}}\mathbf{r}(t)\).

book_ref.quote: represent the velocity vector of the particle, which is tangent to the curve

blocks.prompt:
41 Find the velocity and acceleration at \(t = 1\) for \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (t^{2} + 1)\,\hat{i} + (2t - 3)\,\hat{j}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = (t^{2} + 1)\,\hat{i} + (2t - 3)\,\hat{j}\) ki \(t = 1\) par velocity aur acceleration nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{v} = 2t\,\hat{i} + 2\,\hat{j}\), \(\mathbf{a} = 2\,\hat{i}\). \(t = 1\) par \(\mathbf{v} = 2\,\hat{i} + 2\,\hat{j}\), \(\mathbf{a} = 2\,\hat{i}\).

book_ref.quote: the derivative of the velocity vector with respect to time

blocks.prompt:
42 Find the velocity and speed at \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) for \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3\cos t\,\hat{i} + 2t\,\hat{j}\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3\cos t\,\hat{i} + 2t\,\hat{j}\) ki \(t = \dfrac{\pi}{2}\) par velocity aur speed nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{v} = -3\sin t\,\hat{i} + 2\,\hat{j}\); \(\dfrac{\pi}{2}\) par \(\mathbf{v} = -3\,\hat{i} + 2\,\hat{j}\), speed \(= \sqrt{13}\).

book_ref.quote: how fast it moves, without direction

blocks.prompt:
43 At some instant \(\mathbf{v} = 5\,\hat{i} - 12\,\hat{j}\). Find the speed and the direction of motion.
(Kisi lamhe \(\mathbf{v} = 5\,\hat{i} - 12\,\hat{j}\) hai. Speed aur direction of motion nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Speed \(= 13\); \(\hat{\mathbf{v}} = \dfrac{5}{13}\,\hat{i} - \dfrac{12}{13}\,\hat{j}\).

book_ref.quote: the direction only (the unit tangent vector)

blocks.prompt:
44 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{3}\,\hat{i} + (t^{2} - 6t)\,\hat{j}\), find when the \(\hat{j}\)-component of velocity is zero and the velocity then.
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{3}\,\hat{i} + (t^{2} - 6t)\,\hat{j}\) mein velocity ka \(\hat{j}\)-component kab zero hai aur us waqt velocity kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{v} = 3t^{2}\,\hat{i} + (2t - 6)\,\hat{j}\); \(t = 3\), aur \(\mathbf{v}(3) = 27\,\hat{i}\) (sirf \(+x\) ki taraf).

book_ref.quote: represent the velocity vector of the particle, which is tangent to the curve

blocks.prompt:
45 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} - t^{3}\,\hat{j}\), is the particle speeding up or slowing down at \(t = 1\)?
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = t^{2}\,\hat{i} - t^{3}\,\hat{j}\) mein \(t = 1\) par particle tez ho raha hai ya aahista?)
blocks.explanation: \(\mathbf{v}(1) = 2\,\hat{i} - 3\,\hat{j}\), \(\mathbf{a}(1) = 2\,\hat{i} - 6\,\hat{j}\); \(\mathbf{v} \cdot \mathbf{a} = 22 > 0\): tez ho raha hai (speeding up).

book_ref.quote: the speed is increasing (speeding up)

blocks.prompt:
46 For \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3t\,\hat{i} + 4\,\hat{j}\), compare \(|\mathbf{r}(1)|\) with the speed at \(t = 1\).
(\(\mathbf{r}(t) = 3t\,\hat{i} + 4\,\hat{j}\) mein \(|\mathbf{r}(1)|\) aur \(t = 1\) par speed ka muqabla karein.)
blocks.explanation: \(|\mathbf{r}(1)| = 5\) origin se faasla hai; \(\mathbf{v} = 3\,\hat{i}\), speed \(= 3\). Speed \(|\mathbf{v}|\) hai, \(|\mathbf{r}|\) nahin.

book_ref.quote: how fast it moves, without direction
